title: Broadcasting Act (Amendment of Third Schedule) Notification 2010 (S 559/2010)
header_as_printed: S 559/2010 / First published in the Government Gazette, Electronic Edition, on 30th September 2010 at 5:00 pm. / NO. S 559 / BROADCASTING ACT (CHAPTER 28) / BROADCASTING ACT (AMENDMENT OF THIRD SCHEDULE) NOTIFICATION 2010 / Made this 28th day of September 2010.
source_provider: Republic of Singapore Government Gazette, e-Gazette (www.egazette.gov.sg); the PDF is served as a static file from assets.egazette.gov.sg
in_force: Made on 28 September 2010 under section 65 of the Broadcasting Act; first published on 30 September 2010 at 5:00 pm; paragraph 1 says it "shall come into operation on 1st October 2010".
obtained_how: One GET request with curl, User-Agent "legalese-commons-source-fetcher/1.0 (+https://github.com/legalese/commons)", at least 4 seconds after the previous request, into a new download directory outside the repository. The assets host serves the PDF with 200; the e-Gazette robots.txt (retrieved the same evening) disallows only /search on www.egazette.gov.sg. The text file is the output of "pdftotext -layout" (poppler) on the PDF, unedited: the PDF has a text layer, so there was no OCR. Page breaks are form-feed characters. The converter may mis-order or drop characters, so the text is an aid for quotation and the PDF is the source.
terms: e-Gazette Terms of Use, https://www.egazette.gov.sg/terms-of-use/ (page says "Last updated on 10 July 2026"), clause 11 "Reproduction of legislation-Gazettes"; read on 2026-11-03; the wording is quoted in the licence note.
evidence_status: The e-Gazette FAQ (https://www.egazette.gov.sg/faq/, read 2026-11-03) says: "Before 9 March 2025, only copies of the Gazette printed by the Government Printer are regarded as prima facie evidence of their contents." This item was published before that date, so this copy is an aid and is not stated to be prima facie evidence.
